Subject: Post-call recap: Dedicated capacity perf validation - SLOs and next steps

Alex - great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned.

Call notes (high level):
- FintechX SLO targets: p95 latency <= 150ms for streaming chat responses (typical chunking/partial streaming), sustained concurrency target ~100 active users, peak burst concurrency ~250.
- Expected request profile: avg prompt size ~400 tokens, average response ~800 tokens, occasional long-context up to 8k. Streaming required for UX.
- Reliability: 99.9% uptime SLA for Dedicated; fallback to hosted RD model variants acceptable for some routes.
- Cost sensitivity: FintechX asked for A100 vs H100 cost/throughput comparison to inform sizing.

Action items / next steps:
1) Redwood to run dedicated capacity perf validation comparing A100 vs H100 for FintechX's workload profile (Aditya / Dev to lead). Deliverable: performance_matrix.xlsx with p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec throughput, GPU utilization, and cost per 1M tokens. (ETA 3 business days)
2) Proposal for reserved throughput / node counts to meet p95 <=150ms at concurrency=100 and plan for burst up to 250. (Marissa to share proposal)
3) FintechX to send sample prompts and an anonymized workload trace if possible (to reproduce prefix/KV cache effects).
4) Schedule POC kickoff: suggested week of 2026-03-22.

Attached: performance_matrix.xlsx (blank template with test vectors), dedicated_proposal.pdf (initial sizing + pricing assumptions).

If I missed anything, flag it - otherwise we'll start the perf runs tomorrow and loop you in with results.

Thanks,

Thanks Marissa - thanks for the clear notes. A few clarifications from our side:

- The p95 <=150ms target is for the interactive streaming UX (we show tokens as they generate). We expect many responses to be under ~300 tokens, but we want the tail to be tight.
- Concurrency: the 100 figure is our steady-state. During market opens we can see short bursts ~250 for 2-5 minutes.
- Context window: we will likely use up to 8k in a subset of flows; need to understand memory/KV cache implications.
- Cost: please include both A100 and H100 configs, and if possible a mixed approach where we route long-context workloads to a different pool.

We will upload a small anonymized trace (sample 500 requests) by EOD Monday. Please also confirm timeline for the perf matrix and whether you need us to redact any PII before sending.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Thanks - looping in some technical detail on how we'll approach the validation so expectations are clear.

Planned validation steps (technical):
1) Reproduce request profile with your sample trace: distribution of prompt/response lengths, and percent of long-context (>4k).
2) Test matrix: run identical workloads on a 1-node and 2-node A100 config and an H100 config (same mem where possible). For each run record: p50/p95 latency (streaming per-token and end-to-end), tokens/sec throughput, GPU util, memory footprint, avg KV cache hit rate.
3) Concurrency runs: steady-state 100 concurrent streams for 30 min, then burst test to 250 for 5 minutes to validate autoscaling and reserved throughput behavior.
4) Streaming behavior: measure time-to-first-byte and median inter-token latency to ensure UX targets.
5) Cost calc: convert GPU-hours to cost-per-1M tokens using our reserved pricing assumptions in the attached spreadsheet.

Questions / asks:
- Please confirm sample trace upload and preferred S3 link or secure drive.
- Do you have a preferred model variant (we can test both the open model you mentioned and our Redwood-verified tuned variant)? The tuned variant tends to reduce token counts for similar quality which can materially affect cost.

We'll start the A100 baseline runs this afternoon once we have the trace. I'll drop the raw perf matrix in the shared doc and post a short summary.

- Aditya
